limitations: The complete dataset was previously examined during exploratory analysis.
The reserved test partition is not independent external validation.
Model configurations were selected during prior development experiments.
Bootstrap intervals are conditional on the fitted models and resampling assumptions.
Lot and batch resampling do not capture all temporal and manufacturing dependencies.
Bootstrap intervals do not quantify individual prediction uncertainty.
Measured quality subgroup analyses are retrospective and descriptive.
Regression predictions are not wafer acceptance classifications.
Input warning thresholds are heuristic rather than calibrated.
Feature attribution does not establish physical causality.
Global explainability results from Notebook 15 describe development-stage fitted models.
Prediction-time APC feature availability requires independent operational verification.
Physical measurement units and official engineering acceptance thresholds are not established.
Computational benchmarks are specific to the local environment.
No test-based model optimisation or model replacement was performed.
